title: ISO-NE Updates CAR-SA Proposal, Agrees to Extend Transition Period

meta.summary:
ISO-NE has announced a series of changes to the second phase of its Capacity Auction Reform project, including extending the proposed transition period from two to three years. 
 The post  ISO-NE Updates CAR-SA Proposal, Agrees to Extend Transition Period  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
